lastAssistantMessage:
The Chrome “Restore pages?” bubble is handled, and Restore is never clicked.

That bubble shows up when QA Chrome’s last session was marked crashed. Clicking Restore reopens old tabs and pulls the test off the page. The correct action is to close the bubble and stay on the current page.

The QA Chrome launch now marks that profile as a clean exit and starts Chrome with the crash bubble hidden. On every web drive, before the page loads and again before the click, the driver looks for “Restore pages?” or “Chrome wasn’t shut down correctly.” If the bubble is there, it closes it. It does not click Restore.

The tester notes say the same thing: that bubble is Chrome, not the app. A screenshot of it is not the Kelyra screen. The bubble was not up just now, so this pass did not have to press it. The next time QA Chrome starts, the launch itself keeps it from appearing.
